## What this changes

<!-- One behaviour change per PR, please, plus the test that pins it. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, tests)
- [ ] A new or changed detector has a fixture test
- [ ] If detector semantics changed, I ran the corpus check in **both**
      directions — what fired that shouldn't have, and what should have fired
      and didn't ([why](../CONTRIBUTING.md#then-check-it-against-a-real-corpus))
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, or a `docs/DECISIONS.md` entry is attached
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] Docs updated if the change is user-facing
